# s291 — TUI queue columns are configurable

A `tui.columns` config key lists which queue columns the TUI shows and in what order, so an owner can trade the claim, size or score cells for title room.

**Findings:** owner, 2026-10-15, s277 relay: asked whether the queue's columns could be chosen by the user after the claim column crowded titles at 80 columns; s277 shipped a fixed rule (claim capped at 8 cells, size dropped below a 50-cell pane) · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** columns in `slicer list` text, new column kinds, and per-session toggles in the TUI.

## Why

s277 added a claim cell to the queue row (`#  ID  status  size  P:score  title`). At 80 columns the queue pane is 38 cells, so every fixed cell costs title room. The owner asked for user-chosen columns on 2026-10-15 and accepted a fixed rule for v1.11.

## Files

- `src/slicer/config.py`: `tui.columns`, a list drawn from `claim`, `size`, `score`, validated like other list keys; the default reproduces s277's layout.
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `item_rows` builds the prefix from the configured list; the narrow-pane rule still drops `size` first.
- `docs/configuration.md`, `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; `tests/test_tui.py`, `tests/test_config.py`.
